title: Batch of restricted Fourier observations
statement: Let $n,m$ be natural numbers, let $J$ be a set of coordinates in $ br^n$, let $S$ be a finite subset of $J$, and let a Boolean target function and three length-$m$ sequences of sign-cube inputs be given. The batch output is the length-$m$ list whose $i$th entry is the rational restricted Fourier weight observation formed from the fixed-coordinate part of the $i$th input in the first sequence, the free-coordinate parts of the $i$th inputs in the second and third sequences, and the target values at the resulting combined inputs.
hypotheses_covered: finite coordinate set J in Fin n
Boolean target function on the n-dimensional sign cube
three functions from Fin m to the n-dimensional sign cube
